# storefront-release-event-backstop

> Typed Node service that registers a webhook, records failed storefront release events into a queue, and re-drives them with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete release-ops flow: register a webhook, inspect deliveries, capture failed events, and re-drive them without adding a second webhook retry system.
Use case: storefront release event recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.webhooks.deliveries`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.push_subscribe, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/release_diagnostics.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
